# HumbleBeeAI Academy — Open AI Engineering Curriculum

> A structured, role-aligned pathway from fundamentals to entry-level AI engineering competence. Free, open-source (CC BY-SA 4.0), built from curated open resources.

## About

HumbleBeeAI exists to cultivate elite-level ethical AI talent and democratize access to real AI engineering competence. This open curriculum provides clear sequencing, measurable milestones, and proof artifacts at every stage.

The curriculum targets five entry-level roles: Data Scientist, Computer Vision Engineer, NLP/LLM Engineer, GenAI Engineer, and AI Software Engineer.

## Curriculum Structure

The default progression:

1. **Engineering Fundamentals** (4 months, 250-310 hours) — Python, math, data skills, tooling
2. **Soft Landing** (6 months, 174-251 hours):
   - **Core Systems** — shared foundations: ML math, deep learning, networking, production deployment
   - **Specialization Tracks** — role-based depth with capstone projects

## Documentation

- [Curriculum Overview](https://academy.humblebee.ai/docs): Mission, target outcomes, architecture
- [Engineering Fundamentals](https://academy.humblebee.ai/docs/engineering-fundamentals): Computational thinking, calculus, probability, data manipulation, IoT
- [Soft Landing Program](https://academy.humblebee.ai/docs/softlanding): Core Systems and Specialization Tracks
- [Core Systems](https://academy.humblebee.ai/docs/softlanding/core-systems): Math & ML, Intro to AI Engineering, Networking, Infra Basics
- [Specialization Tracks](https://academy.humblebee.ai/docs/softlanding/specializations): Track overview and comparison
- [Computer Vision Track](https://academy.humblebee.ai/docs/softlanding/specializations/computer-vision): CNNs, object detection, YOLO
- [Data Science Track](https://academy.humblebee.ai/docs/softlanding/specializations/data-science): Statistics, evaluation, ML modeling
- [NLP & LLMs Track](https://academy.humblebee.ai/docs/softlanding/specializations/nlp): Embeddings, transformers, RAG, agents, fine-tuning
- [Generative AI Track](https://academy.humblebee.ai/docs/softlanding/specializations/generative-ai): Diffusion models, speech (ASR/TTS), multimodal
- [AI Software Engineering Track](https://academy.humblebee.ai/docs/softlanding/specializations/software-engineering): APIs, databases, testing, DevOps, CI/CD
- [Learning Resources](https://academy.humblebee.ai/docs/resources): Curated external resources
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/humblebeeai/int.academy-curriculum): Source code and content
